notes:
• Your photo and name at the top of Home, with today's date below. Tap them to add or change them. They stay on this phone and in your backups.

• A cleaner, roomier look: text across the app is a little smaller and lighter, so screens breathe more, in the spirit of bKash.

• On Wealth, Add account is now at the top of your accounts, so you never scroll to find it.

• A DPS now shows the instalments you have paid in its amount, with the count next to the rate.

• App updates in Settings: your version, what is new, one Check for updates for the app, banks and rates together, and a switch to check automatically. A new version now pops up once with Download or Later.

• Report preview has a Print button at the top.

• The "Your money's safety" card is gone from the Wealth overview. The Tk 2 lakh warning when you add a deposit stays.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.2.25 or newer cannot be restored on an older version.
